detail.title: [MDL-A100] Wi-Fi disconnects repeatedly when switching access points
detail.description_html:
Symptom
Wi-Fi drops every time the device roams between two access points on the same SSID.

ItemValue
Reproduction rate8/10
BuildDEMO.BUILD.0101

[ 4935.358407] wlan0: deauthenticating by local choice

history.comment: Reproduced on the latest build. Collecting air logs.

history.cause: Roaming threshold was too aggressive after the driver update.
history.countermeasure: Adjusted roaming RSSI threshold and added hysteresis. Fixed in DEMO.BUILD.0105.

history.comment: Verification scheduled for the next build.

detail.title: [MDL-B200] Camera app freezes when recording 4K HDR video
detail.description_html:
The camera preview freezes about 30 seconds into 4K HDR recording. The app recovers after being force-closed.

  • Occurs only with HDR enabled
  • Not observed at 1080p

history.comment: Looks related to encoder buffer allocation. Assigned to the camera team.

detail.title: [MDL-C300] Battery drains 15% overnight in standby
detail.description_html: Standby current is higher than the previous release. Wakelock analysis is in progress.
